caseNameFull: GAIR Et Al. v. PECK Et Al.
attorneys: Howard Hilton Spellman for appellants., Louis J. Lejko.witz, Attorney General of New York, and James 0. Moore, Jr. for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

.The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari- is denied.
